title: Follow a note through its request contract
summary: Diagnose a bounded FastAPI request mismatch and verify the committed result.

objectives.statement: Trace a value from the outgoing JSON field into the receiving contract and verify a committed save.

scenario.context: A notes request contains the intended text but no note is saved. Inspect the sender, receiver and actual validation evidence before selecting a mapping change.
scenario.initial_state_description: This isolated verification run begins without stored exercise rows.

artifacts.label: The unchanged outgoing request
The actual receiving model contract
artifacts.content:
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

class NoteCreate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    content: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)

question.title: Recall the report mapping
question.prompt: A report form provides name and format. Which mapping change preserves the information and satisfies the contract?

options.label: Place format inside an output object and retain name at the root.
Rename format to body and keep it at the root.
Send the unchanged JSON as a string instead of an object.

hints.text: Trace the request data from its sender into its receiving model.
Compare each outgoing field location with the required receiving location.
Use the missing and extra validation fields before investigating database code.

explanations.title: What the runtime evidence establishes
explanations.text: The receiver requires content and forbids the outgoing body field. The unchanged request produces HTTP 422 with missing content and extra body validation errors, and saves no note. A content mapping succeeds only when HTTP 201, valid response data, no validation errors and one independently read row agree, including row identity.

explanations.title: Feedback after your saved response
explanations.text: Values and structure both matter. The receiving contract places zone inside destination; a flat zone does not satisfy that nested object.

explanations.title: Feedback after your saved response
explanations.text: Trace each value into its receiving location. The contract expects output.format, while name remains at the root. A rename or string conversion does not supply that object.

misconceptions.statement: Containing the intended value alone means a request satisfies its contract.
misconceptions.suggested_feedback: Compare both the value and its receiving field location; presence alone is insufficient.
